resources.string: Manage sing-box and built-in protocol cores. Each core has its own stable and test channels.
Choose a channel to check, download and apply. A test release may be older than stable; compare the displayed versions before switching.
No local core for this channel. Check for updates first.
No compatible ArcaenBox core is published for this channel yet. Your enabled core is unchanged.
Downloads are matched to this device and verified with the ArcaenBox signing key. You can restore the bundled stable core at any time.
The VPN will stop before changing this core. Reconnect after applying to use the selected version.
Download verified. Apply this core to enable it.
Core applied. Reconnect to use it.
Snell 6 requires the test core. Open Kernel manager → Snell → Test release → Apply selected core.
